text: Taking the egg with `take egg` gained 5 points (score 0->5).
Entering through the slightly ajar window with `enter window` gained 10 points (score 5->15).
Descending through the opened trap door with `down`, while carrying the sword, gained 25 points when reaching the Cellar (score 15->40).
Taking the painting with `take painting` gained 4 points (score 40->44).

The death was caused by carrying the painting when trying `climb chimney`; after dropping it, the thief appeared, and attacking him twice with the sword ended in death. Death reduced the score from 44 to 34.
Moving the leaves revealed a grating, but `open grating` reported that it was locked; no way to unlock or enter it was found.
`open egg` did not work: the game said you had neither the tools nor the expertise, so the egg was never opened.
The chimney looked promising, but `climb chimney` failed while carrying the painting; after dropping the painting, climbing the chimney was never retried.
The west wooden door looked like an exit, but it was described as nailed shut and was never opened.
The steep metal ramp looked like a route upward, but `climb ramp` failed because it was impossible; it was never climbed.
Pouring water on the garlic with `pour water on garlic` only spilled and evaporated the water; no useful garlic result was achieved.
